instruction:
You are given a `90°` sector annulus template `/home/user/Desktop/cyclic_base.inp`.
Complete the following from the command line:

1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/cyclic.inp`:
- Define cyclic symmetry with 4 sectors (full `360°`)
- Define symmetry faces on both sector sides (Master and Slave)
- Apply pressure `10 MPa` on the inner surface

2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `cyclic.dat`:
- Extract maximum Mises stress on inner wall
- Compare against full-cylinder Lame solution (`23.13 MPa`)
- Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `max_mises, lame_error_percent`

4. Do not use the CGX GUI.
